strongest_case: The strongest defensible case is that v8 preserves the coherent common-prefix lower-bracket assay while repairing nearly all finite v7 defects without enlarging the experiment. Exact architecture ratification now narrowly authorizes only two CPU/no-model V6S8_T03 sealers and their declared reset evidence, while every model-conditioned target action, result, feedback, training use, model call, and GPU operation stays behind the later manifest ratification. A2 makes the one-manifest stop rule unambiguous. A3 reduces the product to audited exact-run statuses, curves, rational values, signs or equality, and literal action/score inequality, with any later design choice expressly heuristic. A4 gives T05 a proportionate discrete sample/update/configuration audit plus exact realized publication, tensor-inventory, and mount verification rather than an unregistered floating-point replay. A5 closes self-confirming T01/T02 goldens through separately derived oracle paths. The five registered tests have the right division of labor: T01 covers public state/action/fork semantics, T02 writer construction and publication, T03 deterministic syntactic selection, T04 exact constructibility and 7B GH200 feasibility before a separately ratified run, and T05 actual-run provenance and release. The visibility matrix has no target-to-model, target-to-life, target-to-writer, H-postfork-to-writer, or Fable-to-pilot edge. No OS-security proof, exhaustive architecture-level receipt schema, duplicate build, replicate, semantic panel, new control arm, or paper-level inference is warranted for that exact-manifest descriptive scope. The sole blocker is not the lifecycle rule itself but failure to make the bound consensus's required lifecycle falsifiers literal in the structured acceptance tests.

concerns.statement: V8 makes the global pre-panel stop rule normative but does not make the predecessor consensus's required lifecycle falsifiers literal in T01, T04, and T05; the interpretations cannot supply those missing test obligations by assumption.
concerns.evidence: The bound v7 consensus D05 required the successor to do three concrete things: T01 must inject every ordinary pre-panel failure phase and assert the forbidden execution suffix; T04 must freeze one lifecycle transition table and branch/cell order; and T05 must verify that the actual suffix stopped or continued exactly under that table. V8 Protocol A2 and the loop stop_condition clearly state the runtime rule, but the structured V6S8_T01 setup says only that an oracle reconstructs 'failure status' and its expected/falsifies fields mention neither phase coverage nor absence of surviving-branch, later-sleep, or panel actions. V6S8_T04 does not require the lifecycle table or branch/cell order, and V6S8_T05 reconstructs status without requiring verification of the legal execution suffix. Both fresh interpretations reveal the gap by adding these requirements in their acceptance-test prose and assumptions: the scientific interpretation says T01 must cover every pre-panel failure point, T04 the lifecycle table, and T05 the legal stop suffix; the systems interpretation makes the same expansion. Those interpretations are explanatory artifacts, not amendments to the exact proposal or its test criteria. As written, an implementation can satisfy the structured T01 expected output while testing only reducer/parser failure status, and T04/T05 have no literal criterion that rejects continued H/E work after a sleep, mount, canary, reset, model, or process failure. Because global stopping was one of the five mandatory v7 rework items and determines legal commands, receipts, resource use, and status provenance before GPU authorization, exact successor bytes must bind this coverage before ratification. The repair needs no new test ID or experiment: strengthen the existing T01 setup/expected/falsifies, T04 setup, and T05 setup/expected to state the already-adjudicated matrix, table/order freeze, and actual-suffix verification.

concerns.statement: The single realized trajectory, four syntactic targets, positive-only writer, and absence of replicate or alternative-writer arms limit every conclusion to the exact manifest, but those are deferred scientific limitations rather than implementation blockers for the literal v8 product.
concerns.evidence: A3 forbids thresholds, effect categories, mechanisms, generic sufficiency, generic harm, and null conclusions; the claim delta additionally forbids transfer, efficacy, continual-learning, and paper claims. T03 promises only reproducible target-blind syntactic selection, not semantic independence or functional correctness. T05 gates only exact-run status and status-permitted literal evidence. Under that boundary, replication, semantic characterization, sham/random-label/control writers, uncertainty analysis, and inferential thresholds belong to a later registered study. Requiring them here would contradict the bound v7 consensus's explicit instruction not to add arms or paper-level requirements. T04 should enforce the current narrow language and data paths, not convert these limitations into new pilot gates.

human_questions: Will a minimal hash-bound successor make the existing V6S8 T01, T04, and T05 criteria literally require the complete pre-panel failure-injection matrix and forbidden execution suffix, one frozen lifecycle transition table and branch/cell order, and audit of the actual legal stop/continuation suffix, without adding a test ID, science arm, retry, resume, or surviving-branch result?

After that blocker is adjudicated and repaired in new exact bytes, will Rohin separately decide whether to ratify only isolated implementation, independent CPU fixtures, and the two narrowly scoped no-model sealers, while preserving the later T04 and exact run-manifest ratification gates for every model call, training operation, target cell, and GPU use?
